$Comment: The entry tier: common, cheap, and the first thing a new player meets. Loot is the shared loot vocabulary every mod on this server speaks, so what a rare mob drops is authored the same way a chest or a station's rare find is. This tier keeps it to one unconditional roll granting the native Mmoscaling_Drops_Rare table (edit Server/Drops/MmoMobScaling/Mmoscaling_Drops_Rare.json to change WHAT falls out). To make a drop conditional or lucky, add Conditions and a Chance to a roll: Chance is a percentage built from a Base plus weighted factor readings, so { "Base": 5, "Factors": [ { "Factor": "hytale:stat", "Param": "MMO_Luck", "Weight": 0.2 } ] } is 'five percent plus a fifth of the killer's luck'. Multipliers.Loot decides how many times this whole block is rolled, so write per-roll amounts and let the multiplier do the scaling.
Name: Rare
